description: Source code for a QR Code generator library in Rust, including classes for QR code structure, segments, error correction, and rendering.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Represents a QR code matrix with methods for encoding data, drawing patterns, and rendering as SVG.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of data to be encoded in a QR code, with static methods for creating segments in different modes.

classes.name: QrSegmentMode
classes.description: Enumeration of QR code segment modes (Numeric, Alphanumeric, Byte, Kanji, Eci).

classes.name: ReedSolomonGenerator
classes.description: Generates Reed-Solomon error correction codewords for QR code error correction.

classes.name: BitBuffer
classes.description: A buffer for accumulating bits, with methods to append bits.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents the QR code version number.

classes.name: Mask
classes.description: Represents the mask pattern used in QR code masking.

methods.name: encode_text
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode string into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encode_binary
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encode_segments
methods.description: Encodes data segments into a QR code with automatic version selection.

methods.name: encode_segments_advanced
methods.description: Encodes data segments with custom parameters and version range.

methods.name: encode_codewords
methods.description: Creates a QR code from version, error correction, data codewords, and mask.
